patch.summary: folk implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement folk by mapping current crm workflows to folk objects, confirming plan gates for contact management (Standard, Premium, Enterprise), lead management (Standard, Premium, Enterprise), pipeline management (Standard, Premium, Enterprise), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail, WhatsApp Business) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: contact management (Standard, Premium, Enterprise)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: folk day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat folk setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Founders and SMB teams running relationship-led sales from LinkedIn/email before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail and WhatsApp Business before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover contact management (Standard, Premium, Enterprise)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Enrichment, magic fields, and AI assistant credits are monthly capped by plan (custom on Enterprise).

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: FAQ references a free plan for downgrades, but live pricing cards emphasize Standard/Premium/Enterprise — free-tier feature limits are not fully documented on the pricing table.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Deals, sequences, dashboards, and API require Premium

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: folk plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · 14-day trial · up to 1 seat · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Standard
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Premium
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: deal management, email sequences, reporting · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep folk rollout
blocks.body: If folk fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft folk object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Salesflare before sunk-cost expansion
